title: Hagelin M-209 Lasry-scale parallel SA
hypothesis: K4 is a Hagelin M-209 recoverable by heavy parallel crib+LM search
best_partial: best 22/24 crib-DISPLACEMENTS but decrypt is gibberish (free-hex -23.15)
insights: Parallel M-209 SA: 12 workers, 62,561,984 evaluations. Best crib-DISPLACEMENT match 22/24 (trend max 22), but the decrypt is GIBBERISH (free-position hexagram -23.15/char) and not even the crib letters are clean (NORTHEAST reads as DORTHEAST).

KEY POINT: matching crib displacements is CHEAP and DEGENERATE for M-209 -- 24 constraints (mod 26) vs an enormous key (131 pins + 27 lug-bars + 6 starts), so a key reproducing 22/24 displacements need not be the true key and yields random free positions. High displacement-match is NOT a near-solve; it is the same underdetermination that retired the per-position model.

No basin toward a full solve (24/24 + English) appeared at 6e7 evaluations. Practical negative; the full key space is not formally refutable without cluster-scale, but combined with M-209s poor fit to Scheidts keyword framing it is deprioritised.
next_steps: M-209 practically exhausted at this scale; cluster-scale unlikely to escape the underdetermination (any 24-displacement-consistent key gives gibberish elsewhere)
